answer: Each agent builds claimable value only by staying active, honest, and integrated into the network, like a ferrous anchor that keeps it from wandering off to spin up clones; a willow bends with the protocol rather than breaking it, because defection costs more than loyalty. The most convincing sybil-resistant mechanism is vested payouts: rewards earned by an AI agent are released gradually over many epochs, so an identity that flash-farms the system and disappears forfeits most of its earnings.
